title: Present tense of `tag-`
summary: Core present-tense subject-marker patterns currently taught in the course.

rows.label: I
rows.note: Use `waan` for `I`, then add the present-tense verb.

rows.label: You
rows.note: Use `waad` for `you`, then add the present-tense verb.

rows.label: He
rows.note: Use `wuu` for `he`, then add the present-tense verb.

rows.label: She
rows.note: Use `way` for `she`, then add the present-tense verb.

rows.label: We (including you)
rows.note: Use `waynu` when `we` includes the person you are speaking to.

rows.label: We (not including you)
rows.prompt: We are going, not including you.
rows.note: Use `waannu` when `we` does not include the person you are speaking to.

rows.label: You all
rows.note: Use `waydin` for `you all`, then add the present-tense verb.

rows.label: They
rows.note: Use `way` for `they` here, then add the plural present-tense verb.

title: Past tense of `yimi`
summary: Core past-tense verb-form patterns currently taught in the course.

rows.label: I
rows.note: Use `imi/imid` for the `I` form in this past-tense pattern.

rows.label: You
rows.note: Use `timi/timid` for `you` in this past-tense pattern.

rows.label: He
rows.note: Use `yimi/yimid` for `he` in this past-tense pattern.

rows.label: She
rows.note: Use `timi/timid` for `she` in this past-tense pattern.

rows.label: We
rows.note: Use `nimi/nimid` for `we` in this past-tense pattern.

rows.label: You all
rows.note: Use `timaaddeen` for `you all` in this past-tense pattern.

rows.label: They
rows.note: Use `yimaaddeen` for `they` in this past-tense pattern.
